content: An epic, hyper-realistic dark fantasy battleground at night, blending the moody, shadowed atmosphere of @0102.png with the deep, mystical blue lighting of @0103.png. Cinematic 120fps high frame rate for ultra-fluid combat motion, extreme high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting, and heavy cinematic mist. The scene is illuminated by the intense, clashing glows of bright neon green and blazing ethereal blue magical energies.
